snippet.title: TankRat | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
What you take becomes what you are.

You are Whitaker, a Sleepwalker - a digitized consciousness inhabiting a Needle, a hardened drone built to endure the storms and horrors of the ECA. Swarms of corrupted TankRats roam a desolated land. Exploit every weakness to bring them down. The only way out is through, and the only way through, is to destroy everything. 

Scavenge, dismantle, and rebuild yourself from the wreckage in this fast-paced, brutal vehicular action adventure game.

Wishlist Now on Steam, PlayStation 5 and Epic Games:
https://www.tankrat.com/linkhub

TankHead players on Epic Games will get their upgrade to TankRat for free!
